name: Night Tales
summary: A bar and club on Bohemia Place that has been going for more than 12 years. It has a covered, heated terrace with a pizza kitchen, the Palm Bar in Arch 14, and a club room with a Funktion-One sound system for DJ nights.

music.notes: DJ-led club nights; the music changes from one night to the next, so check the listings.

accessibility.notes: The venue is at ground level, with disabled access through the main entrance; Bohemia Place is reached from Mare Street.

cost.notes: The venue says the terrace is usually free to get into; when it isn't, details go out on its social media.

evidence.quote: A cornerstone of East London nightlife for over 12 years, our space features three unique spaces designed to host revellers from open to close.
Open from 6pm every weekend, the terrace seats up to 200 guests and is home to Sons of Slice Pizza Restaurant.
Our lively, covered and heated terrace is perfect for enjoying crafted cocktails and premium beers from early evening through late night.
Arch 14 houses our iconic Palm Bar and is ideal for group bookings of all sizes
Featuring a Funktion-One sound system, an embracing dance floor, and finely tuned line-ups of the world’s best DJs.
Night Tales, 14 Bohemia Place London E8 1DU
This totally depends on the night! We play everything, including house, disco, tech etc
All customers must provide physical ID prior to entry to prove they are at least 18 years old.
entry to our 6000sq ft terrace is free most of the time. If it’s not, we would announce more information on our socials
Spanning 9,000 sq ft with a 600-capacity, Night Tales brings together indoor and outdoor spaces
Bohemia Place is accessible via Mare Street, the venue is on ground level and disabled access via main entrance.
